subject: Clarify: weekly invoice cadence, PO identifier fields and NET terms
messages:
From: Eleanor Price <eleanor.price@starlite-health.com>
To: markus.k@redwood.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: procurements@starlite-health.com
Date: Sat, 10 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: PO fields + weekly invoices / NET60 request

Hi Markus / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week. Procurement flagged a couple of items we need to confirm before we can push the PO through our ERP:

1) PO identifier: our AP system requires a primary PO number (up to 16 chars) and a secondary field labeled "ContractRef" that must match the contract ID we have on file. Can Redwood accept a secondary reference field on invoices?

2) Invoice cadence: we prefer a weekly invoice run for usage-based services (Monday close, Tuesday delivery to our AR), rather than monthly. Are you able to support weekly invoicing?

3) Net terms: our standard is NET60 for first-year vendors. Will Redwood consider NET60 for Starlite Health? We understand this may affect discounting.

4) PO stub: for our initial onboarding we can send a PO stub that omits tax ID until vendor onboarding completes — will finance accept that as interim support?

Attached: Starlite_PO_Example_2025.pdf (example of the PO fields our ERP emits).

Happy to hop on a quick call if it's easier.

Best,
Eleanor
Eleanor Price
Director, Strategic Procurement
Starlite Health

---

From: markus.k@redwood.com <markus.k@redwood.com>
To: Eleanor Price <eleanor.price@starlite-health.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, priyom.d@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 10 Jan 2026 12:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: PO fields + weekly invoices / NET60 request

Eleanor — thanks for the clear summary and the example PO. Quick answers and a couple of clarifying asks below. I'm copying Priyom (pricing) and Vanessa (finance ops).

1) Secondary reference field: yes, we can map a "ContractRef" to an invoice custom field. Our billing system supports an additional free-text PO metadata field (we typically call it "PO.Reference"). Can you confirm the exact label your ERP prefers ("ContractRef" vs "Contract ID") so we can mirror it?

2) Weekly invoices: we can support weekly invoice runs but there are two constraints to call out:
  - Minimum invoice amount: because of downstream payment runs we ask for a $250 min per invoice or else those small invoices are aggregated at our side (we can net them at month-end if that helps).
  - Delivery timing: our Monday-close / Tuesday-delivery cadence works, but to reliably cut early-Monday invoices we need usage data finalized by Sunday 23:59 PT. Will your internal teams be able to provide usage/consumption confirmations by then?

3) NET60: Priyom — is NET60 acceptable for this new account from a pricing/credit perspective? Priyom, any recommended offset (e.g., nominal discount or commit) we should propose?

4) PO stub interim: finance typically needs tax ID and remit address before finalizing onboarding. However — we have accepted PO stubs for initial provisioning when paired with a signed SOW and proof of purchase authorization. Vanessa, can we accept a stub for the onboarding milestone?

I'll attach our standard PO template to show required invoice fields (Redwood_PO_Template_v3.pdf). If helpful we can also propose a split-invoice approach (weekly usage + monthly summary invoice) to limit AR noise.

Short call option: Mon 11 Jan 10:30am PT — available?

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
---

From: procurements@starlite-health.com <procurements@starlite-health.com>
To: markus.k@redwood.com
Cc: Eleanor Price <eleanor.price@starlite-health.com>, Dan Chen <dan.chen@starlite-health.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 08:17:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: PO fields + weekly invoices / NET60 request

Hi Markus / team —

Thanks for the quick reply and the template. To confirm the details from our side:

- Label: our ERP expects the secondary field to appear as "ContractRef" (no spaces).
- Weekly timing: our operations team can sign off on usage by Sunday 18:00 PT (we'll target that to give you buffer).
- Minimum invoice: $250 min is acceptable; we can add a note to AP to allow low-value invoices while onboarding if aggregation causes trouble.
- NET60: procurement supports NET60; final approval will come from treasury, but we have a precedent for NET60 for strategic partners in year one. If Redwood needs an offset, we'd prefer a small onboarding credit rather than a price increase.
- PO stub: we can supply a stub for provisioning provided Redwood issues an invoice referencing the stub PO and follows up with the full PO within 30 days.

Attached: example PO (see earlier). We are happy to accept the split approach (weekly usage + month-end consolidated summary) to reduce manual reconciliation.

Can you confirm the exact invoice reference layout you will include (fields and delimiters) so our AP mapping team can pre-configure rules?

Thanks,
Procurement Team
Starlite Health

---

From: markus.k@redwood.com <markus.k@redwood.com>
To: procurements@starlite-health.com, Eleanor Price <eleanor.price@starlite-health.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, priyom.d@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 16:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: PO fields + weekly invoices / NET60 request

Eleanor / team — great, thanks for confirming. Summary & next steps below so everyone has the same expectations: 

Summary of agreement points:
- Invoice references: we'll include two metadata fields on each invoice PDF/EDI export: "PO.Number" (primary, up to 16 chars) and "ContractRef" (secondary). Both will also be present in the invoice XML/CSV we export for your ERP. Example row: PO.Number=STL-458219;ContractRef=CON-2026-049
- Weekly run: Redwood will cut weekly invoices on Tuesday (reflecting usage through Sunday 23:59 PT). We will aim to deliver files to your AR SFTP by Tuesday 07:00 PT.
- Minimum invoice: $250; sub-$250 usage will be batched into the month-end consolidated invoice unless you request otherwise.
- NET60: Redwood can accept NET60 for Starlite Health on deal ST L-2026-049 with the following condition: a $15k onboarding credit will be applied to the first month to offset the extended payment. Priyom / finance approved this offset as a one-time trade.
- PO stub: Redwood will accept a PO stub to enable provisioning provided the full PO arrives within 30 days.

Action items:
1) Markus to send Redwood_PO_Template_v3.pdf (attached) and a sample CSV export layout to Starlite AP by EOD Tue 13 Jan.
2) Starlite procurement to confirm SFTP details and sample primary PO numbers to validate parsing.
3) Priyom to confirm discount/credit booking code and confirm whether the onboarding credit should be shown as a separate line item or a one-time invoice adjustment (@priyom.d).
4) Vanessa to log the NET60 credit exception with finance and create a temporary vendor record for the PO stub onboarding.

If that reads correctly, we'll lock the onboarding checklist and flip the provisioning switch once we have your SFTP and the PO stub.

Thanks all — quick call can still help if there are any integration edge cases.

Markus
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
---
